scenario: `default` enables every live capability per [LDIA.9.2] (LFCA.10.6, the id, is a tombstone); the deferred ones are false everywhere. Pinned via `use default` + every-action-class smoke: emit + log + cache all compile cleanly. Companion to LDET.5b which pins the trivial use-default path.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Sig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Marker scope ttl 1_min:
    x: Int

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
    emit Sig logical v: 1
    cache key: "k" value: 1
